_comment: Per-engine knobs. The harness/time-management defaults live in retro/timeman.py; these are convenient overrides and the canonical roster description.

shannstein.description: Selective forward pruning: search only the top-K plausible moves.

copybook.description: Plays by the book: a named opening book, then chess-primer maxims (incl. endgame principles) refined by a positional layer (pawn kicks, outposts, rim, tempo). Narrates the opening/rule and its reasons. No search.

beeline.description: King-tropism eval with a shallow alpha-beta motor.

mirror.description: Mirrors the opponent's last move; falls back to a random engine when the reflection is illegal. Designed to play Black.
